label: Assertion in a truth sense: Asserting p in sense s commits the speaker to AssertionCommitment T s…
definition: Asserting p in sense s (`TruthSense`: absolute, or relative to an agent) commits the speaker to `AssertionCommitment T s p`, i.e. to p being true in that sense. The commitment is not a claim that the assertion is correct.
note: The issue #397 assertion layer. A sourced account of assertion (e.g. Aristotle's affirming and denying, Metaphysics IV.7) would replace this stipulation.
